## Setup & Data Retrieval

```{r libraries}
library(quantmod)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(TTR)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r config}
# SPDR Sector ETFs
sector_etfs <- data.frame(
  Symbol = c("XLK", "XLI", "XLU", "XLY", "XLF", "XLB", "XLC", "XLV", "XLP", "XLRE", "XLE"),
  Sector = c("Technology", "Industrial", "Utilities", "Consumer Discretionary",
             "Financial", "Materials", "Communication", "Health Care",
             "Consumer Staples", "Real Estate", "Energy"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Last 10 years
end_date <- Sys.Date()
start_date <- end_date - years(10)
```

```{r fetch-data, cache=TRUE}
# Fetch 10 years of data from Yahoo Finance
all_data <- list()
for (sym in sector_etfs$Symbol) {
  tryCatch({
    all_data[[sym]] <- getSymbols(sym, src = "yahoo", from = start_date, to = end_date, auto.assign = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("[OK] %s loaded\n", sym))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("[ERROR] %s: %s\n", sym, e$message))
  })
}
```

## Sector Analysis Functions

```{r functions}
# Trend Strength: 20-day MA momentum
calc_trend_strength <- function(prices, period = 20) {
  if (length(prices) < period + 1) return(0)
  ma <- SMA(prices, n = period)
  ma_clean <- na.omit(ma)
  n <- length(ma_clean)
  if (n <= period) return(0)
  current_ma <- ma_clean[n]
  past_ma <- ma_clean[n - period]
  if (is.na(current_ma) || is.na(past_ma) || past_ma == 0) return(0)
  return(round(((current_ma - past_ma) / past_ma) * 100, 2))
}

# Trend label classification
get_trend_label <- function(trend_pct) {
  strength <- ifelse(abs(trend_pct) > 2.0, "Strong ", "")
  if (trend_pct > 0.5) return(paste0(strength, "Bullish"))
  if (trend_pct < -0.5) return(paste0(strength, "Bearish"))
  return("Neutral")
}

# Regime Score (0 = Lagging, 1 = Weakening, 2 = Improving, 3 = Leading)
calc_regime_score <- function(change_pct, trend_pct) {
  score <- 0
  if (change_pct > 1.0) score <- score + 1
  if (change_pct < -1.0) score <- score - 1
  if (trend_pct > 1.0) score <- score + 1
  if (trend_pct < -1.0) score <- score - 1
  if (abs(trend_pct) > 2.5) {
    if (trend_pct > 0) score <- score + 1 else score <- score - 1
  }
  return(max(0, min(3, score + 1)))
}

get_regime_label <- function(score) {
  c("Lagging", "Weakening", "Improving", "Leading")[score + 1]
}
```

## Calculate Sector Metrics

```{r calculate-metrics}
results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(sector_etfs)) {
  sym <- sector_etfs$Symbol[i]
  data <- all_data[[sym]]
  if (is.null(data)) next

  prices <- as.numeric(Cl(data))
  n <- length(prices)
  if (n < 252) next

  last_price <- round(prices[n], 2)
  prev_price <- prices[n - 1]
  change_pct <- round(((last_price - prev_price) / prev_price) * 100, 2)
  trend_pct <- calc_trend_strength(prices)
  trend_label <- get_trend_label(trend_pct)
  regime_score <- calc_regime_score(change_pct, trend_pct)
  regime_label <- get_regime_label(regime_score)

  # Multi-timeframe returns
  ytd_idx <- which(index(data) >= as.Date(paste0(year(end_date), "-01-01")))[1]
  ytd_return <- ifelse(!is.na(ytd_idx),
                        round(((last_price - prices[ytd_idx]) / prices[ytd_idx]) * 100, 2), NA)
  one_yr <- round(((last_price - prices[max(1, n - 252)]) / prices[max(1, n - 252)]) * 100, 2)
  three_yr <- round(((last_price - prices[max(1, n - 756)]) / prices[max(1, n - 756)]) * 100, 2)
  five_yr <- round(((last_price - prices[max(1, n - 1260)]) / prices[max(1, n - 1260)]) * 100, 2)
  ten_yr <- round(((last_price - prices[1]) / prices[1]) * 100, 2)

  # Volatility
  log_returns <- diff(log(prices))
  vol <- round(sd(tail(log_returns, 252)) * sqrt(252) * 100, 2)

  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Symbol = sym, Sector = sector_etfs$Sector[i], Last = last_price,
    Change_Pct = change_pct, Trend_Pct = trend_pct, Trend_Label = trend_label,
    Regime_Score = regime_score, Regime_Label = regime_label,
    YTD_Return = ytd_return, One_Year = one_yr, Three_Year = three_yr,
    Five_Year = five_yr, Ten_Year = ten_yr, Volatility = vol,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

results <- results %>% arrange(desc(Change_Pct))
```

## Current Sector Performance {.tabset}

### Daily View (Color-Coded)

```{r daily-table}
# Row color function
get_row_color <- function(pct) {
  if (pct > 2.0) return("#2d8f2d")
  if (pct > 0.5) return("#4CAF50")
  if (pct > 0) return("#6dbf6d")
  if (pct > -0.5) return("#c8c832")
  if (pct > -1.0) return("#d4a017")
  if (pct > -2.0) return("#e67e22")
  if (pct > -3.5) return("#d35400")
  return("#c0392b")
}

daily_df <- results %>%
  mutate(
    `Change %` = sprintf("%+.2f%%", Change_Pct),
    `Trend Strength %` = sprintf("%.2f%% %s", Trend_Pct, Trend_Label),
    `Regime` = sprintf("%d %s", Regime_Score, Regime_Label)
  ) %>%
  select(Symbol, Sector, Last, `Change %`, `Trend Strength %`, Regime)

daily_table <- daily_df %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**SPDR SECTOR FUNDs**"),
             subtitle = sprintf("Daily Performance | %s", Sys.Date())) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"),
                          cell_fill(color = "#1a5c1a")),
            locations = cells_title()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"),
                          cell_fill(color = "#333333")),
            locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "white"), locations = cells_body()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = Symbol)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Symbol, `Change %`, `Trend Strength %`, Regime)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = Last)

for (i in 1:nrow(results)) {
  daily_table <- daily_table %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = get_row_color(results$Change_Pct[i])),
              locations = cells_body(rows = i))
}

daily_table <- daily_table %>%
  tab_options(table.background.color = "#1a1a2e", table.font.size = px(14))

daily_table
```

### Long-Term Returns

```{r long-term-table}
lt_df <- results %>%
  arrange(desc(Ten_Year)) %>%
  mutate(
    `YTD` = sprintf("%+.1f%%", YTD_Return),
    `1 Year` = sprintf("%+.1f%%", One_Year),
    `3 Year` = sprintf("%+.1f%%", Three_Year),
    `5 Year` = sprintf("%+.1f%%", Five_Year),
    `10 Year` = sprintf("%+.1f%%", Ten_Year),
    `Vol (Ann.)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", Volatility)
  ) %>%
  select(Symbol, Sector, Last, YTD, `1 Year`, `3 Year`, `5 Year`, `10 Year`, `Vol (Ann.)`)

lt_df %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Long-Term Sector Returns**"),
             subtitle = sprintf("Multi-timeframe returns as of %s", Sys.Date())) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"),
                          cell_fill(color = "#2c3e50")),
            locations = cells_title()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(color = "white"), cell_fill(color = "#34495e")),
            locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%

  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = Symbol)) %>%

  tab_options(table.background.color = "#1a1a2e", table.font.size = px(14))
```

## Sector Performance Chart (10 Years Normalized)

```{r performance-chart, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# Build normalized price series (base 100)
chart_data <- data.frame()

for (sym in names(all_data)) {
  data <- all_data[[sym]]
  if (is.null(data)) next
  prices <- Cl(data)
  normalized <- as.numeric(prices) / as.numeric(prices[1]) * 100
  df <- data.frame(
    Date = index(data),
    Price = normalized,
    Symbol = sym,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  chart_data <- rbind(chart_data, df)
}

# Merge with sector names
chart_data <- chart_data %>%
  left_join(sector_etfs, by = "Symbol")

ggplot(chart_data, aes(x = Date, y = Price, color = Symbol)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "SPDR Sector ETFs - 10 Year Normalized Performance (Base = 100)",
    subtitle = sprintf("From %s to %s", start_date, end_date),
    x = "", y = "Normalized Price (Base 100)",
    color = "Sector ETF"
  ) +
  theme_dark() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#16213e"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "white", size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#00ff88", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#2a2a4a"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.7)
```

## Sector Rotation Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Monthly returns heatmap for the last 12 months
heatmap_data <- data.frame()

for (sym in names(all_data)) {
  data <- all_data[[sym]]
  if (is.null(data)) next

  # Get monthly returns for last 12 months
  monthly <- to.monthly(data, indexAt = "lastof")
  monthly_returns <- monthlyReturn(Cl(data))
  last_12 <- tail(monthly_returns, 12)

  df <- data.frame(
    Month = format(index(last_12), "%Y-%m"),
    Return = round(as.numeric(last_12) * 100, 2),
    Symbol = sym,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  heatmap_data <- rbind(heatmap_data, df)
}

heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  left_join(sector_etfs, by = "Symbol")

ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Month, y = reorder(Symbol, Return), fill = Return)) +
  geom_tile(color = "#1a1a2e", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.1f%%", Return)), color = "white", size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#c0392b", mid = "#f39c12", high = "#27ae60",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "Return %") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Sector Returns Heatmap (Last 12 Months)",
    x = "", y = ""
  ) +
  theme_dark() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#16213e"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#00ff88", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

## Market Summary

```{r summary}
cat(sprintf("Leading: %d | Improving: %d | Weakening: %d | Lagging: %d\n",
            sum(results$Regime_Score == 3), sum(results$Regime_Score == 2),
            sum(results$Regime_Score == 1), sum(results$Regime_Score == 0)))
cat(sprintf("Average Daily Change: %+.2f%%\n", mean(results$Change_Pct)))
cat(sprintf("Best Performer: %s (%+.2f%%)\n", results$Symbol[1], results$Change_Pct[1]))
cat(sprintf("Worst Performer: %s (%+.2f%%)\n",
            results$Symbol[nrow(results)], results$Change_Pct[nrow(results)]))

positive <- sum(results$Change_Pct > 0)
negative <- nrow(results) - positive
breadth <- ifelse(positive > negative, "BULLISH",
                  ifelse(negative > positive, "BEARISH", "NEUTRAL"))
cat(sprintf("Market Breadth: %d up / %d down -> %s\n", positive, negative, breadth))
```
